items.title: An integral universally injective surjective morphism of algebraic spaces induces an equivalence of small etale topoi
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)

items.difficulty_reason: The theorem asserts that for an integral, universally injective and surjective f : X -> Y, pullback along f is an equivalence between the small etale topoi. The proof is organised as a three-part verification. Faithfulness is settled first by exhibiting a pair of distinct morphisms and separating them after base change. Fullness is the substantive part: given an etale V over Y and a morphism over X, one must descend the morphism back to Y, which is done by reducing to the case of an integral universal homeomorphism of schemes and then producing etale schemes over the base whose base changes realise the given data. The third step verifies that the functor is essentially surjective by the same reduction. What is not routine is that the reduction to schemes must respect the etale sites on both sides, and that both fullness and essential surjectivity depend on the same descent construction. Retained author proof at lines 1328-1412.
